correctness.rationale: The two BALFI identities impose exactly 3 admissible bit pairs at each inside incidence (A,j), j in A, and 2 outside; every incidence independent. Each type has m*2^(m-1) positions, hence 6^L labelled. Imposing ciw fixes outside and restricts inside to 2 choices, and classical negation fixes the first bit: 2^L, 4^L, intersection one. Boolean-reduct automorphisms are S_m; complement of A equivariantly pairs inside/outside cycle counts. Cyclic Burnside fixed incidence count is f(sigma^t)*2^(c(sigma^t)-1), yielding N_m(q)=sum q^o/m!. A nonidentity atom permutation fixes at most m-2 atoms and has at most m-1 cycles; all other inside incidences have orbit length at least 2, giving o <= L-(m+2)2^(m-3), hence asymptotic rigidity. Uniform inside colorings give independent Bernoulli(1/3) contradictions and Binomial(L,1/3). Proof quantifiers m>=1, asymptotic bound m>=2 verified.
